description:
1. Create an internal app in the [DingTalk developer console](https://open-dev.dingtalk.com/)
2. Enable [Wiki.Workspace.Read](https://open.dingtalk.com/document/development/get-my-documents) and the [Drive file-list read permission](https://open.dingtalk.com/document/orgapp/obtain-the-file-list)
3. Publish the app and grant access to the required spaces
4. Copy AppKey and AppSecret, then enter the operator’s union ID
